title: Dated telegraph strip
description: A narrow station printout carrying a sequence of harbor signals from the evening Annika died.

title: Clock escapement key
description: A modified clock key whose stop marks can be compared with the Saint Vigga mechanism.

title: Salinity comparison slide
description: A prepared glass slide preserving the mineral profile used to distinguish rainwater from seawater.

title: Blue cullet fragment
description: A sharp cobalt reject fragment whose fracture surface is fresh beneath an artificially aged crust.

title: Crushed ampoule seal
description: A flattened medicine seal recovered beside the private dining service corridor.

title: Contractor access card L4
description: A ferry-company contractor card with level-four service access and abrasion around its magnetic stripe.

title: Removed batch label
description: A peeled sedative batch label carrying adhesive fibres from the clinic's controlled-drug ledger.

title: Tidegate water vial
description: A sealed freshwater sample taken from the Tidegate settling cistern.

title: Orange sling fragment
description: A torn high-load sling fragment carrying black hull paint and Tidegate grit.

title: Loose brass drawer tag
description: A numbered brass tag worked loose from the private maritime index cabinet, with fresh scratches around one rivet hole.

title: Mismatched Eidolon inquiry folios
description: Different fibre, trimming, and type pressure show that official 1995 inquiry pages were replaced after binding.

title: Pressure-drum chart strip
description: A timestamped meteorological chart showing the evening squall and freshwater rainfall peak.

title: Structured withdrawal slip
description: A bank counterfoil grouping three cash withdrawals beneath misleading repair references.
